simple.meaning: מִקְסָם (miqçâm) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an augury.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

occurrences.englishText: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have not spoken?”
